title: FiniteStructureUnitLiftExistence
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and finite type. Write $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and $j_n:X_n\to X$. Let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical transition immersion, specified by both pullback projection equations. Let $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ be the canonical composition comparison of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $p_n:Y_n\to X_n$ be finite, with $g_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ giving cartesian transition squares and $j_{n+1}\circ p_{n+1}\circ g_n=j_n\circ p_n$. Let $G$ be a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent] on $X$ with support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and suppose isomorphisms $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong p_{n,*}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ commute with $c_n$ and the canonical affine base-change maps followed by the structure-sheaf pullback maps [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Put a_n:G to (j_n p_n)_* O_Yn equal to the adjoint of psi_n [lem-weil-pbc-finite-structure-adjoint-transitions]. Suppose mu:G tensor G to G is an O_X-linear symmetric product, with a_n(mu(x tensor y))=a_n(x)a_n(y) on every open. There is an O_X-linear map eta:O_X to G satisfying mu(eta(1) tensor x)=x on each open, and a_n(eta(r))=(j_n p_n)^sharp(r) for each scalar section r. This states only the unit step, without constructing any ring sheaf or algebra maps.

proof.text: Obtain Q, q and the compatible reduced factorizations v_n from the supporting-quotient-system theorem. Q and G are coherent with proper support.

Transport v_n from the pinned composition comparison to the chosen comparison used by grothendieck_existence. The projections j_n are closed immersions, as base changes of quotient closed immersions. The fully proved private compatible_family_change helper uses compatible_family_comparison_equiv and leaves v_n unchanged. Full faithfulness lifts v_n to w:Q to G. Set eta=q followed by w. The fully proved private adjoint-precomposition helper and the reduction equation of w give the scalar formula for eta.

Define L:G to G by the inverse right unitor, identity tensored with eta, and mu. The tensor-section formulas and the given symmetry give L(x)=mu(eta(1) tensor x). Multiplicativity and the scalar formula at 1 show a_n(L(x))=a_n(x). Naturality of the adjoint and its Hom-equivalence injectivity imply (j_n^*L) followed by psi_n equals psi_n; cancel psi_n to get j_n^*L=identity. Uniqueness in grothendieck_existence for G to G gives L=identity. Evaluating on sections proves the left-unit law. No associativity or properness of O_X is needed in this existence step.

theorem finite_structure_unit_lift_existence
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (hi n)).symm)
    (Yn : ℕ → Scheme.{u})
    (fnY : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    [∀ n, IsFinite (fnY n)]
    (gn : ∀ n, Yn n ⟶ Yn (n + 1))
    (hcart : ∀ n, IsPullback (fnY n) (gn n) (i n) (fnY (n + 1)))
    (hw : ∀ n, gn n ≫ (fnY (n + 1) ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) =
      fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hproper : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f G)
    (ψ : ∀ n, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn n).ringCatSheaf))
    (hψ : ∀ n,
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (ψ (n + 1)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (fnY (n + 1)) (fnY n) (i n) (gn n)
          (hcart n).flip.w (SheafOfModules.unit (Yn (n + 1)).ringCatSheaf) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (fnY n)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit (gn n))) =
        (c n).hom.app G ≫ (ψ n).hom)
    (μ : G ⊗ G ⟶ G)
    (hcomm : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (x y : Γ(G, U)),
      μ.app U (tmulSection x y) = μ.app U (tmulSection y x))
    (hμ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
        let a : Γ(G, U) → Γ(Yn n, (fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
          fun x ↦ (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) G (ψ n).hom).app U x
        ∀ (x y : Γ(G, U)),
          a (μ.app U (tmulSection x y)) = a x * a y) :
    ∃ η : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ G,
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(G, U)),
        μ.app U (tmulSection ((η.val.app (op U)).hom (1 : Γ(X, U))) x) = x) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)),
        (Scheme.Modules.finiteStructureAdjoint
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))) (fnY n) G (ψ n).hom).app U
          ((η.val.app (op U)).hom r) =
          (fnY n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).app U r)
